description: A feature branch whose every commit is SKIPPED. The declaration commit carries no 'phase N' token and neither does the one that follows it, so Invoke-ScopeCheck returns without grading either, the run exits 0, and before the phase-5 remediation scripts/ritual-checks.ps1 summarised the whole thing as 'scope-check      OK'. The skip lines were always printed; what was missing is a run-level verdict that says no commit was graded at all — which is GAP-027 in the one member that had a counter for it and did not use it. Every territory is declared and every file is inside it: nothing here is a violation, and that is the point.
